evidence.quote: Licensed firms should observe the JFIU’s transitional arrangements as set out below:
the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2. The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.

lost_or_added_conditions: All three actual executable children are UNENCODED: the interval and follow-up children report E_UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE, and the contact child reports E_SCHEMA. Executable preservation is therefore unestablished.
The proposed Boolean urgency fact does not encode the exact clock-time interval or link an urgent submission event to that interval.
The proposed contact fact does not explicitly bind the contact to the same STR, its urgency, or the blackout interval; unrelated historical contact could satisfy an inadequately grounded valuation.
The licensed-firm actor, every applicable STR, direct contact, and specified contact destinations remain prose conditions without demonstrated executable enforcement.

The proposed implication returns true outside the urgency condition; this must mean inapplicability rather than substantive compliance. Its Boolean compliance label also does not independently preserve the source's should/please modality.
The prose retains uncertainty about completed filing and later follow-up, but no executable child preserves the separation between pre-launch contact and the post-implementation submission trigger.
value.rationale: The narrative decomposition substantially retains the parent's bounded urgent-contact direction and unresolved filing mechanics. However, the requested correspondence concerns actual executable children, and none is encoded successfully. The proposed judgment-dependent Boolean facts do not establish actor, event, temporal, quantifier or modality correspondence. The sources support contact during the specified blackout and separately require resubmission for off-platform STRs submitted following implementation; they do not establish that blackout contact completes filing or automatically triggers that later rule. Stated residuals and preservation declarations cannot establish executable preservation.
